value.rationale: Cycles are a canonical family for domination parameters, and prior work already settles only the scalar independent Roman minimum. An exact all-function structure theorem and weight distribution is a natural strengthening: it records every feasible weight, explains the minimum configurations, and yields a reusable cyclic-composition model rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
